from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-113cf243.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uniform = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            uniform.append((grid[r][0], 'r', r))
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1:
            uniform.append((vals[0], 'c', c))
    sep_color = Counter(color for color, _, _ in uniform).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [i for color, axis, i in uniform if axis == 'r' and color == sep_color]
    sep_cols = [i for color, axis, i in uniform if axis == 'c' and color == sep_color]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    cells = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[ri]+1, row_edges[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_edges)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci]+1, col_edges[ci+1]
            cells.extend(grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
    bg = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[ri]+1, row_edges[ri+1]
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci]+1, col_edges[ci+1]
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep_color
                        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row_out.append(1 if marks > 1 else bg)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
